# Peak Apps Studio

> Peak Apps Studio is an independent software studio. Its free browser tools live at peakappsstudio.com/<tool>/: most of them work on the files in your browser and upload nothing, and some offer a one-time Pro upgrade. The studio also publishes mobile apps.

Each tool page explains what the tool does, how to use it and its limits; the guide pages under a tool answer one question each, with sources and a "last checked" date where rules or prices are involved.

## Browser tools

- [Tumbler Template Generator](https://peakappsstudio.com/tumbler-template/): Exact flat templates for tapered tumblers, cups and mugs, and a warp that bends your design to fit.
- [Name Cut Files](https://peakappsstudio.com/name-cut-files/): Paste a list of names or an Etsy orders CSV and get welded, same-size SVG cut files laid out on your mat.
- [KDP Coloring Book Interior Maker](https://peakappsstudio.com/kdp-coloring-book/): Turn coloring pages into an Amazon KDP-ready interior PDF with the right bleed, margins and blank backs.
- [Print Only Your Size](https://peakappsstudio.com/sewing-pattern-printer/): Open a layered PDF sewing pattern and print just your size, on any computer, iPad or Chromebook.
- [Quilt Label Maker](https://peakappsstudio.com/quilt-label-maker/): Print-ready quilt labels for inkjet fabric sheets, with quilt-block borders and a Quilt of Valor check.
- [Etsy Tax Summary](https://peakappsstudio.com/etsy-tax-summary/): Year totals from your Etsy statement CSVs: sales, refunds, every fee and the Schedule C lines.
- [Menopause Adjustments at Work](https://peakappsstudio.com/menopause-adjustments/): Ideas for changes at work from the Acas and GOV.UK guidance, chosen by symptom, and a polite request letter to your manager.
- [Photo Date Fixer](https://peakappsstudio.com/photo-date-fixer/): Put the real date, local time and location back into the photos and videos of a Snapchat Memories export, in your browser.
- [Chatbound](https://peakappsstudio.com/character-ai-export-viewer/): Open the password-protected ZIP from your Character.AI data export and read, search and save your chats in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Earhours](https://peakappsstudio.com/spotify-minutes-listened/): See your Spotify minutes listened so far this year, top artists, songs and podcasts, from your own data file, in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Yearlap](https://peakappsstudio.com/strava-year-in-review/): A free Strava year in review from your own export: distance, hours, climbing, sports, streaks and story cards, in the browser, in any export language.
- [Nightjar](https://peakappsstudio.com/oura-export-viewer/): Every night's sleep stages, HRV, heart rate, temperature, SpO2 and stress from your own Oura export, without a membership.
- [Dayfold](https://peakappsstudio.com/daylio-viewer/): Open a Daylio backup on a PC, Mac or any browser: calendar, search, mood charts and the Year in Pixels. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Wristory](https://peakappsstudio.com/samsung-health-viewer/): See your Samsung Health data on a PC, from the app's own Download personal data files: steps, sleep stages, heart rate, weight, workouts, stress and blood oxygen, in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
- [Notelift](https://peakappsstudio.com/colornote-viewer/): Open a ColorNote backup on a PC or in any browser: read, search and save every note, with your backup password. Nothing is uploaded.

## Home project tools (3D)

- [Without Planning](https://peakappsstudio.com/without-planning/): Check a home extension, garden room or heat pump in 3D against England’s permitted development rules and Ireland’s 2026 exemptions.
- [Dropped Kerb Check](https://peakappsstudio.com/dropped-kerb/): Check a driveway in 3D against your council’s dropped kerb rules, with the planning answer and the fees, before you pay to apply.
- [Catio Designer](https://peakappsstudio.com/catio-designer/): Design a catio for your window, wall or balcony in 3D, with the mesh and shelf checks and every board and roll of mesh to buy.
- [Coop Designer](https://peakappsstudio.com/coop-designer/): Design a chicken coop and run for your flock and your yard in 3D, with the space, nest box and hardware-cloth checks and every board to buy.
- [Sim Rig Designer](https://peakappsstudio.com/sim-rig-designer/): Design a sim racing cockpit around your own body in 3D, in 2x4, metric lumber or aluminium profile, with the angle checks and every board and bracket to buy.

## Pay equity tools (UK, Ireland, EU)

- [Pay Gap Report](https://peakappsstudio.com/pay-gap-report/): The statutory gender pay gap measures from a payroll export, for the UK, Ireland and the EU directive, worked out in your browser.
- [Equality Action Plan](https://peakappsstudio.com/equality-action-plan/): A gender pay gap and menopause action plan from GOV.UK’s 18 actions, with the rules and word limits checked as you write.
- [Job Evaluation](https://peakappsstudio.com/job-evaluation/): Score roles on skills, effort, responsibility and working conditions, and see which jobs are work of equal value.
- [Pay Transparency Kit](https://peakappsstudio.com/pay-transparency/): Request letters for workers and Article 7 answers for employers, with the EU directive’s status in all 27 countries.

## Websites for small businesses

- [Website design service](https://peakappsstudio.com/web/): One-page websites for small businesses with scroll animation and 3D. We draft the homepage before payment. Starter $390, Cinematic $1,490, first year of hosting included. Three live demos: a barber, a hair transplant clinic and a seaside café.
- [Web sitesi yaptırma (Turkish)](https://peakappsstudio.com/tr/web-sitesi/): İşletmeler için tek sayfalık, kaydırdıkça hareket eden web siteleri. Hızlı Site 9.900 TL, Sinematik Site 29.900 TL, ilk yıl barındırma dâhil.

## Apps

- [TRAILER WRECK: Derby Racing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.peakapps.trailerwreck): A demolition derby game for Android. Ten cars fight to stay on one moving trailer in three-minute matches, online with friends or offline against AI. Free, no ads, and optional purchases never sell speed or power. The trailer is at the top of https://peakappsstudio.com/.
- [OkulTakip](https://peakappsstudio.com/apps/okultakip/): Çocuk takip uygulaması OkulTakip: çocuğun okula vardığında, okuldan çıktığında ve eve geldiğinde sen sormadan bildirim gelir. Hesap yok, QR ile eşleşme, deprem modu. iPhone için ücretsiz.
